title: Dialog Mechanism
description: Introduce a "Dialog" mechanism reusing the Introduction mechanism's visual language: when a dialog opens, a full-screen glass veil (ui-glass-veil, z-tutorial) covers the screen, and a centered dialog box styled identically to the introduction walkthrough info box (getGlassSurfaceClass("panel") + rounded-lg border p-double shadow-lg) presents a title/body and a staged form (Vec<ActionArgDef>). Contract-first: DialogDefinition (id, title, body, args, submit_action, submit_label, cancel_action, cancel_label) on AppDefinition.dialogs, validated in AppBuilder::build_definition (unique ids, submit/cancel refs resolve to declared actions, per-dialog arg validation shared with per-action arg validation via an extracted validate_arg_defs helper). New HostEffect::OpenDialog { dialog_id, args } (kernel-altitude, plain String/Value) opens a declared dialog; plugins emit it via ActionEmit::effect from an ActionKind::Shell action. Shell (framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx) owns OverlayState.dialog { dialogId, seedArgs } and a SET_DIALOG reducer action, applies openDialog host effects, and mounts a new UIDialog component (ui/js/react/index.tsx) as a sibling of UIIntroduction. UIDialog reuses a new shared GLASS_OVERLAY_BOX_CLASS constant (extracted from UIIntroduction's info-box recipe) so the two mechanisms are styled identically by construction, stages local form state via effectiveActionArgs/missingRequiredArgs, and renders fields through an injected renderField prop (os-shell passes its exported renderStagedArgControl so ui-react never imports from framework/renderer). Submit dispatches the plugin-declared submit_action with merged effective args through the ordinary onAction path; cancel (Escape, veil click, or Cancel button) dispatches cancel_action if declared. Proof-of-concept: Puzzle 3D gets an "Add Object" dialog (openAddObjectDialog shell action) driving the existing addObjectKind operation's objectKind select arg.
summary: Implemented the Dialog mechanism reusing the Introduction mechanism's visual language. Contract (framework/core/rs/lib.rs): DialogDefinition (id, title, body, args: Vec<ActionArgDef>, submit_action, submit_label, cancel_action, cancel_label) as a new AppDefinition.dialogs field, plus a new kernel-altitude HostEffect::OpenDialog { dialog_id, args } variant. AppBuilder (framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs): .dialog() with validation in build_definition (unique dialog ids, submit/cancel action refs resolve against declared actions including framework-injected ones, per-dialog arg validation) — extracted a shared validate_arg_defs() helper reused by both per-action and per-dialog arg checks, eliminating duplication. TS mirror regenerated and re-exported (framework/core/js/index.ts), including a hand-extended HostEffect union. React (ui/js/react/index.tsx): extracted GLASS_OVERLAY_BOX_CLASS from UIIntroduction's info-box recipe into a shared exported constant so the introduction box and the new UIDialog are styled identically by construction; UIDialog renders a full-screen glass veil (click-to-cancel) plus a centered dialog box with a staged form via an injected renderField prop (os-shell passes its exported renderStagedArgControl so ui-react never imports from framework/renderer), Cancel/Submit buttons, and Escape-to-cancel. Shell (framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx): OverlayState.dialog { dialogId, seedArgs }, SET_DIALOG reducer action, an openDialog branch in applyHostEffects (validates the dialog id exists on the active app, console.errors and ignores otherwise), and mounts UIDialog as a sibling of UIIntroduction — submit closes then dispatches submit_action through the ordinary onAction path with merged effective args, cancel closes then dispatches cancel_action if declared. Puzzle 3D (puzzle/plugin/rs/lib.rs) got a real "Add Object" dialog: a new openAddObjectDialog shell action (early-returns ActionEmit::effect before the document-diffing scaffolding, since it never touches the projection) opens a dialog whose single select field drives the existing addObjectKind operation. Tests: 3 new core serde/typegen tests, 7 new plugin builder validation tests (all passing, 57 total in semio-framework-plugin), 2 new puzzle3d tests (manifest declares the dialog; dispatching the shell action emits exactly one OpenDialog effect with no document mutation — 20/21 d3 tests pass, the one failure is a pre-existing unrelated fill-precompute timing test untouched by this diff), 1 new SET_DIALOG reducer test (147 total in framework-renderer-react). Verified live end-to-end in the puzzle-3d-react-dev browser: full-screen glass veil identical in style to the introduction box, pre-seeded default select value, Submit dispatches addObjectKind and the object count increments (1→2, confirmed via direct DOM inspection), Cancel button and veil-click both dismiss without mutating the document, no console errors throughout.
